answer: Every identity posts a 500 POA bond before answering, and a karst ledger entry links each grade to its bond. When grades diverge from consensus by more than 20 percent, the chain opens a juniper slash trail, burns a slice of the bond, and publishes the evidence. One honest agent risks one bond worth $12; ten fakes must lock ten bonds, $120, and lose them together when their grades correlate. Repeat divergence freezes the identity for three epochs, and the willow record stays public for audit.
